parallels.note: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper…

translations.web: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;
translations.bsb: And they mounted on it four rows of gemstones: The first row had a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald;
translations.kjv: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.
